Heartburn after drinking ` [Highlight start] commonly happens because alcohol—or caffeine—relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), letting stomach acid flow back up into the esophagus [Highlight end] ` . Alcohol also irritates the lining of your throat and stomach and can boost stomach acid production.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF13evL6j2Nh1ZbHHkHKvtQXEr4Rbt1H35m_31p00X71nQdFOSc3zTmM2iO-VOBXtouU29ohgJ5fhalJYWK3pqYM2m5wtt3EHVidBYCp8SoQgvvkrE5ipfNJpK3OiujNDFmLAzijTyn2HMpx7QicbctzK02eUAoqlOyQPAMUhETf-gjCQL4LXIguha3USXI_wsMvOb-A9b65gfqzP7sWblsmgI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF179Ku8P73cMMhaY43vvvNqbxcNvMmC7LGWyGEx_xAi3X7VLFddl06exfcT6XvPjkz6qfQttIIx139GC-7p9XHHyfILuLGScI5e5PAIX_B7lPfN_20FW1hYw99ZwXkfVExevWX8xq-iZTZuBt3yIzHTFcq4W4cPCHry8tdrW1VvtfHwD-9QsEkDQp)

### Why It Happens

- **Relaxed LES valve:** The ring of muscle between your stomach and esophagus loosens, allowing acid to escape upward.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXy6WCsF1aD1plmHbTfTJzyRC9xxQUvuTUMrR0C09t6uHZEuypc_T7c0jwlY28reCggSLOMLKU78rseqxe8QLQcsL7E_pmgEzatrWmZ_y0Iqby_F6ipiWiTQhCw3y6ofRr-rR8uXwx6E5ux1gMxw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM)
- **Irritation and acid:** Alcohol irritates sensitive tissues and increases stomach acid, making reflux more painful.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF179Ku8P73cMMhaY43vvvNqbxcNvMmC7LGWyGEx_xAi3X7VLFddl06exfcT6XvPjkz6qfQttIIx139GC-7p9XHHyfILuLGScI5e5PAIX_B7lPfN_20FW1hYw99ZwXkfVExevWX8xq-iZTZuBt3yIzHTFcq4W4cPCHry8tdrW1VvtfHwD-9QsEkDQp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM)
- **Mixers and habits:** Carbonated or acidic mixers, heavy or fatty meals, late-night drinking, and smoking can all make symptoms worse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXujp1qWZ6RryXXtpda4RG_ys1kzSbwnnq61A_ApeNP1jA3EeFYd98aK6FKZhU2-xTL7Dc3WRBYeX3UduHca9HQchJH2T8J-F_Ow-F-hywFWL89n4LD4VZn6ntzqPzybZqULqraxqIuAnbCjTjJsZlLUF5AYl_Q_lWJQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXy6WCsF1aD1plmHbTfTJzyRC9xxQUvuTUMrR0C09t6uHZEuypc_T7c0jwlY28reCggSLOMLKU78rseqxe8QLQcsL7E_pmgEzatrWmZ_y0Iqby_F6ipiWiTQhCw3y6ofRr-rR8uXwx6E5ux1gMxw)
- **Other drinks:** Coffee and caffeinated beverages can also relax the LES and trigger reflux in susceptible people.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF13evL6j2Nh1ZbHHkHKvtQXEr4Rbt1H35m_31p00X71nQdFOSc3zTmM2iO-VOBXtouU29ohgJ5fhalJYWK3pqYM2m5wtt3EHVidBYCp8SoQgvvkrE5ipfNJpK3OiujNDFmLAzijTyn2HMpx7QicbctzK02eUAoqlOyQPAMUhETf-gjCQL4LXIguha3USXI_wsMvOb-A9b65gfqzP7sWblsmgI)

### Ways to Relieve and Prevent It

- **Sip water:** Drink plain water slowly to rehydrate and help dilute stomach acid.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF179Ku8P73cMMhaY43vvvNqbxcNvMmC7LGWyGEx_xAi3X7VLFddl06exfcT6XvPjkz6qfQttIIx139GC-7p9XHHyfILuLGScI5e5PAIX_B7lPfN_20FW1hYw99ZwXkfVExevWX8xq-iZTZuBt3yIzHTFcq4W4cPCHry8tdrW1VvtfHwD-9QsEkDQp)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXy6WCsF1aD1plmHbTfTJzyRC9xxQUvuTUMrR0C09t6uHZEuypc_T7c0jwlY28reCggSLOMLKU78rseqxe8QLQcsL7E_pmgEzatrWmZ_y0Iqby_F6ipiWiTQhCw3y6ofRr-rR8uXwx6E5ux1gMxw)
- **Stay upright:** Avoid lying down right after drinking or eating, and prop your head up if resting.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXH-gtCOT2W_yQtd0hSjMRGNchjh2YWCjpXbKoKUBlvUOaHIs1QAC9-UtNZlQpMRFDTlI34_O6h-tDYMdcBuprmWUoBYcqkUU190trIfpgJ350_t4kX47gZlFM2gb2t8P7zg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXy6WCsF1aD1plmHbTfTJzyRC9xxQUvuTUMrR0C09t6uHZEuypc_T7c0jwlY28reCggSLOMLKU78rseqxe8QLQcsL7E_pmgEzatrWmZ_y0Iqby_F6ipiWiTQhCw3y6ofRr-rR8uXwx6E5ux1gMxw)
- **Skip extra triggers:** Hold off on coffee, citrus juice, carbonated drinks, and heavy or greasy foods while your stomach settles.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXy6WCsF1aD1plmHbTfTJzyRC9xxQUvuTUMrR0C09t6uHZEuypc_T7c0jwlY28reCggSLOMLKU78rseqxe8QLQcsL7E_pmgEzatrWmZ_y0Iqby_F6ipiWiTQhCw3y6ofRr-rR8uXwx6E5ux1gMxw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXujp1qWZ6RryXXtpda4RG_ys1kzSbwnnq61A_ApeNP1jA3EeFYd98aK6FKZhU2-xTL7Dc3WRBYeX3UduHca9HQchJH2T8J-F_Ow-F-hywFWL89n4LD4VZn6ntzqPzybZqULqraxqIuAnbCjTjJsZlLUF5AYl_Q_lWJQ)
- **Consider OTC options:** Antacids or acid reducers (like H2 blockers) can help manage occasional symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXujp1qWZ6RryXXtpda4RG_ys1kzSbwnnq61A_ApeNP1jA3EeFYd98aK6FKZhU2-xTL7Dc3WRBYeX3UduHca9HQchJH2T8J-F_Ow-F-hywFWL89n4LD4VZn6ntzqPzybZqULqraxqIuAnbCjTjJsZlLUF5AYl_Q_lWJQ)

More details on causes and prevention are available from [Medical News Today](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM) and Hartford HealthCare . If heartburn is frequent, severe, or accompanied by trouble swallowing or chest pain that could be heart-related, check with a healthcare professional.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-XgJxBWR9sHi30rcnqgi7HHd07eRBialqI-nr4GM_vnPJxv7TVXtm31cgKA5pVHDwlKSQZLP8OvGB-eSdcEtYf9uQKneJbctNDmJrgkeLeT4kz0B7-qs04TbwlQ1nPEMaX_GICPONzc9YMZr1xtVJN5QG-DNldBmHcMeHj2bIfKuPQfzQv4lDi6Iem-mUFh8g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX4QguN5LWK4x2u-Nv1aG5Z6BXqjq2HWuRVyvi2fENY4uKOMMTR06P9kStdONydkEJZ-MLyDmJj3vr-h_zOjAaL96EHhfqquvxf_s4_KbouMhz462CYx0_kGTyWXUdJaWiHw1uKQM2-F4sFqalYDzd7oM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF179Ku8P73cMMhaY43vvvNqbxcNvMmC7LGWyGEx_xAi3X7VLFddl06exfcT6XvPjkz6qfQttIIx139GC-7p9XHHyfILuLGScI5e5PAIX_B7lPfN_20FW1hYw99ZwXkfVExevWX8xq-iZTZuBt3yIzHTFcq4W4cPCHry8tdrW1VvtfHwD-9QsEkDQp)To help narrow this down, what **type of drink** caused the heartburn (such as alcohol, coffee, or soda), and **how often** does it happen?
